column1: # Coding quarantine removes a runtime, model, or workspace from the coding
# lane after a containment failure or a hazard record, the way
# scripts/quarantine.tsv removes a checkpoint from the router. scope names
# what the subject is; the service refuses a job naming a quarantined
# subject before any grant is checked. The ledger ships empty: rows arrive
# from measured failures, not from precaution.
